name: account-details
purpose: Full account detail panel — large identicon, label, wallet label, balance and the full address in monospace chunks, with a top-right close button — shown when inspecting an account in Hub flows.

props.name: address
props.description: User-friendly Nimiq address; renders the identicon and the AddressDisplay chunks.

props.name: image
props.description: Optional image URL (e.g. a shop logo) shown instead of the identicon; falls back to the identicon if it fails to load.

props.name: label
props.description: Account label. If it equals the address, an empty label is rendered instead.

props.name: walletLabel
props.description: Wallet (account group) label shown under the account label as an uppercase nq-label.

props.name: balance
props.description: Balance in luna; rendered through Amount with 2 decimals when set.

props.name: editable
props.description: Render the label as a LabelInput field; changes are emitted as 'changed'.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder for the editable label input.

notes: Sample state: address NQ33 DH76 PHUK J41Q LX3A U4E0 M0BM QJH9 QQL1 (the checksum-valid upstream storybook address), label 'Savings Account', walletLabel 'Keyguard Wallet', balance 2712415141213 luna -> '27 124 151.41' (Account passes its default decimals=2 to Amount; U+202F narrow no-break space grouping above 4 integer digits), editable=false, hosted in a 420x560 box (the storybook mounts it in a SmallPage). The panel is upstream's Account.vue in layout 'column' plus AddressDisplay(copyable) and CloseButton; their markup/styles are inlined since Account has no own registry entry. SCOPED-CSS SPECIFICITY TRAP: AccountDetails' '.account >>> .identicon' overrides (18rem identicon, 3rem label/balance, padding 0) share specificity (0,2,0) with Account.vue's '.column .identicon' rules and win only by source order — keep the AccountDetails block AFTER the Account block (runtime injects children on import, parent last). AddressDisplay renders its root AS a Copyable ('copyable address-display format-nimiq' on one element) because AccountDetails hardcodes copyable; resting state (tooltip/background at opacity 0). The Vue port wraps AddressDisplay's chunks in the registry Copyable instead (upstream merges both components onto one root; visually identical, but the flattened DOM differs there). Identicons via @nimiq/iqons@1.6.0 pinned on jsdelivr with Iqons.svgPath probing the vendored assets/img/iqons.min.svg first (same recipe as the identicon component). The image prop and editable/LabelInput path are ported in the Vue variant but not part of the pixel sample.
